(2) The camera pulls back to reveal the man standing next to a white camper van under a grey awning. He holds the lantern up to the camera while speaking. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the lantern's digital interface and control panel, which features several buttons and a small LCD screen. The man's thumb is visible as he interacts with the controls. (4) The man demonstrates the lantern's lighting functions, switching on a warm internal glow and then a bright forward-facing spotlight. (5) In a medium shot, the man tries to hang the lantern on a thin metal pole using a hook, but the lantern slips down the pole. (6) A series of close-up shots show the man's hands peeling off a yellow and black warning sticker from the side of the lantern. (7) The final shot shows the lantern hanging steadily from a hook, fully lit with a soft warm light. The background is a scenic view of a lake and hills at twilight.
